messages:
alyssa: Heads-up: Nebula Systems (HW + SI) requested a private marketplace offer + co-announce tied to their partner day on 2026-08-12. Need commit bands, SKUs, simple renewal language, and an announceable blurb. Who can take lead?
ben: I can draft commit bands now. Prefer 12mo with quarterly true-up and optional 24mo locked-price.
priya: Sales asks for a 60-day early-enrollment credit (applies to months 1-2). Also want fast-start service as add-on.
mike: Ops: marketplace needs SKU mapping, billing cadence, and note that HW rebate is partner-managed. We can pass through with partner PO + SOW.
legal-bot: Do not promise HW rebate in public copy. Add auto-renew opt-out and 30-day cancellation window. I'll draft clauses.
ben: Draft tiers (USD, annual commit):
```
- Kickstart: $7k/mo -> 6% discount, no HW rebate
- Growth: $45k/mo -> 14% discount + $12k HW pass-through, 60-day enrollment credit (months 1-2)
- Enterprise: $160k/mo -> 23% discount + $45k HW pass-through + 2w fast-start credit
Optional 24mo lock -> +3% discount.
```
priya: Sales ok with Growth/Enterprise. Keep fast-start as add-on for Growth.
mike: Suggested SKUs: rwd-neb-kickstart-v1, rwd-neb-growth-v1, rwd-neb-enterprise-v1, rwd-neb-faststart-2w.
alyssa: Announce plan: internal announce 2026-08-05, public + partner press 2026-08-12. I'll craft co-branded blurb and loop comms.
ben: I'll post a final pricing spreadsheet and private-offer JSON by EOD.
legal-bot: I'll upload redlines by tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: Marketplace note saved: listing must include "partner-managed rebate" FAQ and link to private-offer redemption URL.
alyssa: Thanks team. Ping me @alyssa if anyone is blocked. :rocket:
